blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept, such as a copyrighted style, a recognizable character,
or unsafe content, from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model while preserving its ability to generate
other content. Existing activation steering methods build an erasure direction mainly from the target
concept and adjust model activations along it at inference time. However, target and retained concepts
often overlap in the model’s representation space, so this direction also contains shared components that
retained concepts rely on. Steering directly along this direction can therefore suppress retained concepts
and harm the generation of non-target content. To address this issue, we propose R etain-aware A ctivation Steer ing ( RASteer ), a training-free method. RASteer first builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve.
Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) then removes components aligned with this subspace from the erasure
direction, making steering more specific to the target. Since fully removing the shared components can
weaken erasure, we further introduce Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). At each layer and denoising step,
OAC uses the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace to control how much of each
shared component is removed, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. Experiments on unsafe-content,
instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks show that RASteer matches or
outperforms the activation steering and weight editing baselines we evaluate, achieving a better
balance between erasure and preservation. 1 1 1 Project page: https://rasteer.cvmlgroup.web.illinois.edu/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) are trained on web-scale data and inevitably learn content that their providers cannot include in their products, such as copyrighted artistic styles, recognizable characters, and unsafe images.
When takedown requests, changes in regulations, or safety audits require removing such content, retraining on filtered data is too costly, while prompt- or output-level filters are easily bypassed ( Rando et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Sarwar et al., 2026 ) .
Concept erasure offers a practical alternative: it directly edits a released model to prevent it from generating a target concept ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and has become a key step in deploying T2I models responsibly.
Such edits must erase the target while preserving all other content, including unrelated styles and characters, as well as open-domain generation.
blocks.zh:
Text-to-image (T2I) 传播模型(Rombach等,2022年)接受网络尺度数据培训,并不可避免地学习到其提供者不能包含在产品中的内容,如有版权的艺术风格,可识别的人物,以及不安全的图像等.
当拆卸请求,修改法规,或安全审计要求去除此类内容时,对被过滤数据的再培训费用太高,而即时或输出级别的过滤则容易被绕出(Rando等,2022;张等,2026;Sarwar等,2026.).
概念消除提供了一个实用的替代方案:它直接编辑一个已发布的模型来阻止它生成一个目标概念(Gandikota等,2023;Kumari等,2023;Gandikota等,2024;Gong等,2024;Lu等,2024;Li等,2026),并已成为负责任地部署T2I模型的关键步骤.
这类编辑必须去除目标,同时保留所有其他内容,包括无关的样式和字符,以及开放域生成.

blocks.en:
Existing erasure methods broadly fall into two categories: weight editing and activation steering.
Weight editing fine-tunes the model or applies closed-form updates to its cross-attention matrices ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , writing these changes into model parameters and increasing the cost of switching or undoing edits.
By contrast, activation steering ( Gaintseva et al., 2026 ; Huu-Tien et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ) keeps model weights fixed and suppresses target concepts by adjusting intermediate activations during inference, allowing edits to be enabled, disabled, or combined.
The erasure direction is constructed from the target concept, and each image patch is gated based on its activation’s alignment with that direction.
blocks.zh:
现有的去除法大致分为两类:重量编辑和活化向导.
重量编辑对模型进行微调,或对其交叉读取矩阵应用封闭式更新(Gandikota等,2023;Kumari等,2023;Gandikota等,2024;Gong等,2024;Lu等,2024;Li等,2026;Liu等,2025;Liu等,2026;Hu等,2026),将这些修改写入模型参数并增加切换或撤销编辑的成本.
相形之下,活化向导(Gaintseva等,2026;Huu-Tien等,2024;Xie等,2025;Zhang等,2024b)通过在推论中调整中间活化,允许编辑被启用,被禁用,或被合并,使模型重量保持不变并压制目标概念.
消除方向是从目标概念中构建的,每个图像补丁都根据它的活化与该方向的对接而入门.

blocks.en:
However, the target’s erasure direction may contain shared components that retained concepts also rely on, causing collateral damage.
In the top row of Figure 1 a, steering along the original direction to erase Sonic turns the retained character Snoopy into an ordinary dog.
Figure 1 b further shows overlap between the alignment scores of target and retained activations: at the default threshold, the gate incorrectly triggers on 65 % 65\% of retained activations and misses 21 % 21\% of target activations.
Raising the threshold reduces false triggers but misses more target activations.
In the bottom row of Figure 1 a, Snoopy remains recognizable after full projection even though it is the erasure target, showing that completely removing shared components can also weaken target erasure.
These observations show the need to incorporate information about retained concepts into the erasure direction to reduce collateral damage and improve target erasure.

blocks.en:
To address these issues, we propose R etain-aware A ctivation Steer ing ( RASteer ), which uses information about retained concepts to refine the erasure direction.
It consists of two modules: Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) and Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC).
ROS constructs a retain subspace from the steering vectors of retained concepts.
It identifies and reduces the shared components of the original erasure direction that align with this subspace, making the direction more specific to the target and reducing suppression of retained concepts.
OAC adjusts the removal strength based on the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace at each layer and denoising step, balancing target erasure and concept preservation.
As shown in Figure 1 c, RASteer further lowers target classification accuracy compared with full projection while maintaining similar accuracy on retained concepts, illustrating how adaptive calibration improves target erasure.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这些问题,我们提议使用关于保留概念的信息来完善消除方向。
它由两个模块组成:保留-正交向导(ROS)和重叠-辅助校正(OAC).
ROS从所保留概念的向量中构建一个保留子空间.
它确定并减少了与这个子空间相适应的原始去除方向的共享部分,使方向更能针对目标,并减少对所保留概念的压制.
OAC根据去除方向和每层保留子空间的重叠并去诺斯级来调整去除强度,平衡目标去除和概念保存.
如图1c所示,RASteer在保持保留概念的类似准确性的同时,进一步降低了目标分类精度与全投影相比,说明了适应性校准如何能改善目标去除.

blocks.en:
We evaluate RASteer on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks, comparing against activation-steering and weight-editing baselines under the same evaluation pipeline.
The results show that RASteer effectively suppresses target concepts while largely preserving retained concepts and general image quality, achieving a better trade-off between erasure and preservation.
Our contributions are:

结果显示RASteer在基本上保留所保留的概念和一般图像质量的同时,有效地压制了目标概念,在去除和保存之间实现了更好的取舍.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Model Editing for Concept Erasure. Fine-tuning methods suppress concepts by
optimizing the denoiser ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) or training
lightweight modules ( Lyu et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Closed-form methods directly
update cross-attention weights: TIME ( Orgad et al., 2023 ) uses least-squares editing,
UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) adds retention constraints, and RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) iteratively erases embeddings that regenerate the target. MACE ( Lu et al., 2024 ) combines
closed-form editing with LoRA fusion for mass erasure Hu et al. (2021) . SPEED ( Li et al., 2026 ) restricts updates
to the null space of preserved concepts, while CURE ( Biswas et al., 2026 ) applies an energy-scaled
spectral projection. These methods encode edits in model weights or trained modules, so switching
or combining edits involves managing the corresponding parameters.

blocks.en:
Inference-Time Steering. The most recent family leaves the weights untouched and edits
the generation process at inference: Safe Latent Diffusion ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) steers the sampling
trajectory away from unsafe content through classifier-free guidance, SAFREE ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) projects prompt embeddings off the unsafe concept’s subspace in text-embedding space,
SAeUron ( Cywiński and Deja, 2025 ) ablates sparse-autoencoder features of the target, and
CASteer ( Gaintseva et al., 2026 ) subtracts the target’s steering vector from cross-attention activations,
keeping the edit reversible and composable. All of them, however, model only the concept to remove : none takes the concepts to keep as input, so a retained concept that shares directions with
the target is suppressed along with it. RASteer keeps this weight-free runtime and supplies the missing
ingredient: it builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve and steers only along the erasure
direction orthogonal to it, with layerwise strength set by overlap.

blocks.en: Sequential and Continual Unlearning. Continual learning studies how models acquire a sequence of tasks or concepts while mitigating interference with previously learned knowledge, whereas online learning emphasizes adaptation to a stream of incoming data or objectives Liu et al. (2020) ; Liu et al. (2021a) ; Liu et al. (2021b) ; Liu et al. (2023a) ; Liu et al. (2023b) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2019) ; Li et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021) ; Luo et al. (2023) ; Fischer et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023) . Sequential unlearning presents a complementary challenge: rather than continually acquiring new knowledge, a deployed model must continually satisfy new forgetting requests while retaining everything else Meng et al. (2022a) ; Meng et al. (2022b) ; Ma et al. (2025) ; Gu et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024) . Repeated parameter editing can accumulate interference across requests, making preservation increasingly difficult. Our setting shares this continual adaptation perspective, but differs in that RASteer performs each edit at inference time without updating model parameters, allowing multiple erasure constraints to be introduced, removed, or combined without parameter drift.

SDXL ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate unsafe content on I2P prompts ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) ,
instances and artistic styles with matched retain concepts, and general open-domain generation on
MS-COCO captions ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . We compare with SPM ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) ,
SAeUron ( Cywiński and Deja, 2025 ) , ESD-x/u ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ) ,
UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) , MACE ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) , and
CASteer ( Gaintseva et al., 2026 ) .

Implementation Details. RASteer is training-free and updates no weights. For each concept, we
precompute its steering vectors offline and reuse them at inference. We steer every cross-attention layer with the OAC rule and no per-concept tuning. We use official code or
released weights under default settings for every baseline. Experiments use NVIDIA A40. Appendix A.1 provides the complete implementation details.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Metrics. We measure erasure and preservation jointly. Concept presence is scored by
CLIP accuracy and CLIP score ( Radford et al., 2021 ) on the erasure target and on every retained
concept. Unsafe content is counted by the exposed body parts detected with

FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measure distribution-level and paired-image
drift from the unsteered backbone’s generations under the same prompts and seeds. For instance and style
experiments, FID is computed against the corresponding unsteered concept generations.

blocks.en: We compare RASteer with all baselines on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure. Detailed unsafe-content statistics are provided in Table 1 . Across these settings, Tables 2 and 3 report general-content preservation and instance/style erasure, respectively. Overall, the results indicate that RASteer offers a favorable erasure–preservation balance: it reduces unsafe detections, produces consistently low classification accuracy on the erased instance and style targets in Table 3 , and keeps retained and open-domain generations close to the unedited model. Additional results on different backbones are provided in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We studied concept erasure through inference-time activation steering, where the target concept may share
substantial representation with concepts that should be retained. We traced the collateral damage of raw
steering to this overlap and proposed RASteer, a training-free method that leaves the model weights unchanged.
Its ROS module removes retain-aligned components from the erasure direction, while OAC adjusts the removal
strength according to the target–retain overlap. Across multiple concept-erasure benchmarks and four Stable
Diffusion backbones, RASteer balances target suppression with preservation of retained concepts and general
generation.

概念中的实质性代表性应予保留。 我们追踪了原始物质的附带损害
引导到这种重叠,并提出了RASteer,一种使模型重量不变的无训练方法.
其ROS模块从去除方向上去除保留对接的组件,而OAC调整去除
根据目标保持重叠的强度。 跨越多个概念时代的基准和四个稳定
传播骨干,RASteer平衡目标抑制,保留保留概念和一般

blocks.en: Limitations. First, our experiments focus on the Stable Diffusion family; extending RASteer to newer architectures such as diffusion transformers and FLUX remains future work. Second, RASteer relies on a predefined retain set, and poorly represented concepts may still be affected. Third, when the target direction overlaps substantially with the retain subspace, the direction available for erasure becomes limited, motivating adaptive retain-set construction or iterative steering.
blocks.zh: 限制。 首先,我们的实验侧重于稳定分化家族;将RASteer扩展到更新的建筑,如扩散变压器和FLUX,仍然是未来的工作. 其次,RASteer依赖于预先定义的保留集,代表性差的概念仍然可能受到影响. 第三,当目标方向与所保留的子空间相重叠时,用于去除的可使用方向变得有限,激发了适应性保留设置的构造或迭接方向.

A backbone-specific reading further separates the failure modes. On SD-v1.4 and SD-v1.5, incomplete
instance erasure often leaves a recognizable silhouette, while stronger interventions can replace the
entire subject or background. In the style rows, some methods suppress the named painter by flattening
the image into repetitive texture rather than preserving the prompt content. SD-v2.1 shows the same
effects more strongly: residual character shapes and dense repeated motifs coexist across methods. The
SDXL rows make collateral damage especially easy to see because its unedited outputs are highly
consistent; the retained Pikachu poses and wave-like compositions stay close under RASteer, whereas some
baselines alter the subject, palette, or spatial structure. Thus the grid distinguishes successful
semantic removal from mere visual degradation.

基线改变对象、调色板或空间结构。 因此,网格区分成功
语义去除单纯的视觉退化.
